nom: TONYMOLY I'm Rice Active Enzyme Exfoliating Cleanser

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including several managing rosacea, report the powder is gentle enough to exfoliate without redness or irritation, but one reviewer with sensitive skin says it gave her tiny pimples the day after using it.
segments.dry: Reports from reviewers with dry skin are split: some say it left their skin smoother and clean without over-drying, but two reviewers with dry skin say it broke them out every time they used it.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report it helps manage excess oil and buildup without stripping, though one reviewer with oily-combination skin found it dried her skin out with continued use and suspects it suits very oily skin better than her own.
segments.combination: Most reviewers with combination skin, including some who describe it as combination-oily or combination-mature, report it exfoliates flaky or oily areas without drying out the rest of their face, though one reviewer with oily-combination skin says it dried out her skin with continued use.
segments.mature: The reviewers who describe mature skin, generally alongside combination skin, say it leaves their face soft and clean without drying it out.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the cleanser as non-drying or even hydrating, but several note it can dry out skin with daily or over-frequent use, recommending it be used only a few times a week and followed with a moisturizer or hydrating serum.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some managing rosacea, say the cleanser calms redness with regular use, one specifically noting no new redness or patchy spots even on very reactive skin.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who mentions the skin barrier says this exfoliant doesn't damage it, unlike harsher options.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer managing hyperpigmentation says the cleanser brightens her skin instantly without the irritation that would otherwise trigger her hyperpigmentation to return.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, or improvement with regular use, including one who says it got rid of stubborn blackheads after a single wash, but a few reviewers report the opposite — breakouts appearing every time they used it, in one case a pattern that repeated across several months whenever she resumed use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin say it helps clear excess oil and buildup from congested areas like the nose, without stripping natural oils.

aspects.libelle: Bottle often appears only half full
Transforms into a rich foam with water
A little goes a long way

extraits.titre: Dry skin/ Not so sensitive/ 1x a Week Usage Review
extraits.texte: Soooo i did NOT like it AT ALL. At first since i was barely figuring out what worked for me, i couldn't believe it was a "gentle exfoliator" but idk what it was in there but it deff broke me out every time i used it.

I purchased this July 2023. I was using it about 2-3 times a week and I noticed that i was breaking out. I stopped using it in September 2023 and my face cleared up by October 2023. I used it again on December 2023 and my face broke out. I used it again February 2024 and again, I broke out. Some of the pros, it's super easy to use. My face did feel very clean after using it. Cons: the bottle was half empty, it made me breakout every time. It's affordable and I'm sure it works for a lot of people, it just didnt work for me. Side note: My skin is more on the dry side. I really wanted to love it.

extraits.titre: I tried it for a month
extraits.texte: The results just werent what i expected for it claiming to exfoliate. I nornally have oily combination skin and I feel like this dried that out, it at first made my skin soft, but then dried my skin out with continued use and hasnt fixed the texture my skin has accumulated on one cheek; that being the opposite i sleep on. I use a cleanser everyday when I shower and this was just not suitable even with cold water it left my skin clean but overly dry feeling the need for immexiate moisturizer for the past few weeks. I even used a tony moly moisturizer but it still did this to my skin type. I just loved the packaging and products by TM mostly, im sure it works great for very oily skin types!

I enjoyed using this product but it cause tiny pimples the day after using it. I have very sensitive skin so this must have not agreed with me. I thought thus was really gentle and if it worked for me I would have bought it again.

i have genuinely the most sensitive skin ever...like 4 month old baby that keeps getting ezcema breakouts level sensitive. this exfoliator is the BEST I AM SO SERIOUS. no redness, no patchy spots, just smooth skin. i would def recommend moisturizing as soon as youve dried your face though!

Gifted by TONYMOLY Amazing rice cleanser that does a phenomenal job of exfoliating and polishing my skin without over drying. I especially love how effective it has been in calming down my rosacea after daily use for 2 weeks.

extraits.titre: If you struggle with acne GET THIS
extraits.texte: This cleanser singlehandedly saved my skin. I've struggled with acne ever since i turned 12 and I'm 22 now. This combined with Cerve sensitive skin lotion has completely cleared my face up. I will be getting this for forever 10/10
